objective: Prove the complete multi-plan worktree lifecycle in disposable repositories and release the portable skill contract
prefetch: Create all lifecycle repositories under a disposable temporary root
Capture source/default SHA and dirty-state invariants before and after the run
Review repo/global skill drift before copying source outward
Run focused proof before core and local-release
constraints: The harness cannot resolve any target to the real repository
No force cleanup, live PR creation, default merge, or external daemon
Global skill copies are reviewed before source overwrites them
Current core/local-release responsiveness is an explicit final-gate dependency
acceptance_criteria: Two disjoint plan runs and their child receipts complete in a disposable repository
Cross-manifest path and shared-resource conflicts block before mutation
Internal execution leaves the default branch unchanged
Docs, skill copies, core, diff check, and local-release prove the final contract
model_tier_reason: The final proof crosses Git lifecycle, concurrency, portable skills, documentation, and release propagation
escalation_triggers: The harness targets the real repository
Global installs contain useful target-only drift
Any proof requires force cleanup or default delivery
